description: Documentation-backed Azure Policy references for the audit-only AI governance catalogue. This file is not an ARM template, initiative, or assignment. documentedEffects records Microsoft capabilities; recommendedInitialEffect is restricted to audit effects or null when unsupported. Honor assignmentProfile exclusions. Verify definitions, parameters, aliases, and availability in the target cloud.

assignmentProfile.description: Custom checks plus 22 simple built-ins; the only assignment parameters are optional per-policy effect overrides that default to Audit/AuditIfNotExists: Azure ML (B06, B07, B10, B12, B29, B32, B35, B36), other AI services (B01, B04, B05, B11, B17, B28, B30, B33, B38, B39, B70, B71, B74), and model deployments (B19). B06, B19, B29, and B30 use fixed hidden settings. Customer-managed key policies, policies needing parameter lists (such as B18 model approval), and public-network-disable checks stay excluded. Other catalogue entries are reference material.

policies.displayName: Bot Service should have local authentication methods disabled
policies.notes: Audits Bot Service disableLocalAuth. Effect-only; no assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Bot Service endpoint should be a valid HTTPS URI
policies.notes: Audits that the bot messaging endpoint is an HTTPS URI. Effect-only; no assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Bot Service should be encrypted with a customer-managed key
policies.notes: Audits Bot Service isCmekEnabled. Effect-only; no assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Azure Health Bots should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
policies.notes: Audits customer-managed key encryption on Health Bots. Effect-only; no assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Azure Health Bots should use Azure RBAC as their access control method
policies.notes: Audits Health Bot accessControlMethod set to Azure RBAC. Effect-only; no assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Container registries should have anonymous authentication disabled.
policies.notes: Audits anonymousPullEnabled=true. Distinct from the registry admin-account check B63. Review an explicit exemption for intentionally public image registries. Audit changes no registry settings; no additional assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: App Service apps should have remote debugging turned off
policies.notes: Checks the web configuration for remoteDebuggingEnabled=false on non-function Microsoft.Web/sites. Does not cover deployment slots or every runtime debugging path. Review temporary debugging exceptions. AuditIfNotExists is report-only; no extra assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Function apps should have remote debugging turned off
policies.notes: Checks remoteDebuggingEnabled=false on applicable Function App web configuration. Preserves workflowapp and azurecontainerapps kind exclusions; deployment slots are not covered. AuditIfNotExists changes no configuration and adds no input fields.

policies.displayName: Azure Kubernetes Service Clusters should have local authentication methods disabled
policies.notes: Audits AKS disableLocalAccounts not true. Private API access does not satisfy this authentication check. Verify Entra integration, RBAC, client access, and emergency access before remediation. Audit does not disable accounts; no extra assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Container Apps should only be accessible over HTTPS
policies.notes: Audits configuration.ingress.allowInsecure=true on Microsoft.App/containerApps. Does not require ingress, govern arbitrary TCP traffic, or test application authentication. Separate from environment private endpoints. Audit only; no extra assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Only secure connections to your Azure Cache for Redis should be enabled
policies.notes: Audits enableNonSslPort=true on Microsoft.Cache/redis. Does not apply to redisEnterprise/Azure Managed Redis and does not verify the negotiated TLS version. Migrate non-TLS clients before remediation. Audit changes nothing; no extra assignment inputs.

policies.displayName: Storage account public access should be disallowed
policies.notes: Audits allowBlobPublicAccess not explicitly false. This is anonymous blob/container read permission, not publicNetworkAccess; authenticated access through approved public networks is not prohibited. Preserves the built-in's Azure Red Hat OpenShift naming exclusions. No extra assignment parameters.

policies.displayName: Secure transfer to storage accounts should be enabled
policies.notes: Audits supportsHttpsTrafficOnly using the built-in's API-version default handling. Does not change protocol settings or validate actual traffic. Review NFS and legacy-client compatibility before remediation. No extra assignment parameters.

policies.displayName: App Service apps should only be accessible over HTTPS
policies.notes: Audits missing or false httpsOnly on Microsoft.Web/sites excluding functionapp kinds. B61 covers applicable Function Apps. Does not test TLS versions, certificates, application authentication, or deployment slots. No extra assignment parameters.

policies.displayName: Function apps should only be accessible over HTTPS
policies.notes: Audits missing or false httpsOnly on Microsoft.Web/sites with functionapp kind, preserving workflowapp and azurecontainerapps exclusions. Does not test function authorization or runtime traffic. No extra assignment parameters.

policies.displayName: Key vaults should have deletion protection enabled
policies.notes: Audits soft delete and purge protection on Key Vault vaults with provider-default and recovery-mode handling. Enabling purge protection is irreversible; this Audit reference does not enable it. Managed HSM is not the target of this built-in. No retention input or extra assignment parameters.

policies.displayName: Container registries should have local admin account disabled.
policies.notes: Audits adminUserEnabled=true on Container Registry. Does not cover anonymous pull or repository-scoped tokens. Review image-pull and build clients before disabling admin credentials; Audit changes nothing. No extra assignment parameters.

policies.displayName: Azure Databricks Workspaces should be in a virtual network
policies.notes: Separate VNet-injection check: audits missing customVirtualNetworkId, customPublicSubnetName, or customPrivateSubnetName workspace parameters. Does not prove subnet existence or placement of serverless compute. B40 separately checks Approved workspace private endpoints.

policies.displayName: Azure Kubernetes Service Private Clusters should be enabled
policies.notes: Related private-API control, not an Approved-connection count: checks apiServerAccessProfile.enablePrivateCluster=true. Does not prove private application ingress, model serving, or every workload's endpoints.

policies.displayName: Storage accounts should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved storage private endpoint connection. Core baseline fixes the managed-service exclusion array to empty; use reviewed scope/exemptions for exceptions. One connection does not prove every blob/dfs/file/queue/table subresource is covered.

policies.displayName: Azure Key Vaults should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved vault connection. The active audit_effect and unused deprecated effect parameters are both fixed to Audit; the deprecated Deny option is not exposed through the initiative.

policies.displayName: [Preview]: Azure Key Vault Managed HSM should use private link
policies.notes: Preview built-in requiring an Approved Managed HSM private endpoint connection. Missing or empty connection arrays produce a finding.

policies.displayName: CosmosDB accounts should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved connection on Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts; the separate mongoClusters resource type is not covered by this built-in.

policies.displayName: Private endpoint should be enabled for PostgreSQL flexible servers
policies.notes: Requires an Approved child connection on flexible servers. VNet-integrated private-access servers use a different networking design; review an exemption for that design instead of interpreting it as public exposure.

policies.displayName: Private endpoint connections on Azure SQL Database should be enabled
policies.notes: Checks Approved connections on Microsoft.Sql/servers, the logical-server parent of SQL databases. Does not cover Microsoft.Sql/managedInstances.

policies.displayName: Azure Cache for Redis should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved child connection on Microsoft.Cache/redis. Existing VNet injection is not evaluated as equivalent private-endpoint existence.

policies.displayName: Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved child connection on Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise, including Azure Managed Redis resources represented by that ARM type.

policies.displayName: Private endpoint connections on Batch accounts should be enabled
policies.notes: Requires an Approved Batch account connection. One connection does not establish coverage of every Batch subresource or pool networking path.

policies.displayName: App Service apps should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved connection on Microsoft.Web/sites, including applicable Function Apps. Private Link plan support and deployment-slot coverage require separate review; App Service plans do not own the endpoint.

policies.displayName: Azure Synapse workspaces should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved workspace connection. This is inbound Private Link, not an outbound managed private endpoint or proof that all SQL/dev subresources are covered.

policies.displayName: Azure Data Factory should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved factory connection. Does not assess outbound managed private endpoints or integration-runtime connectivity.

policies.displayName: Azure Purview accounts should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved account connection; portal, ingestion, and source connectivity need separate validation.

policies.displayName: Azure Monitor Private Link Scope should use private link
policies.notes: Checks Approved connections on Microsoft.Insights/privateLinkScopes. This shared resource owns telemetry Private Link; this rule alone cannot detect a Log Analytics workspace or Application Insights component that has never been linked to a scope.

policies.displayName: Container registries should use private link
policies.notes: Requires an Approved connection on Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries, independently of public access. Applies to all registries in the assignment scope; Premium is required to configure Private Link. Does not prove DNS or runtime connectivity.

policies.displayName: Azure Health Data Services de-identification service should use private link
policies.notes: Audits absence of an Approved private endpoint connection on Microsoft.HealthDataAIServices/deidServices. Does not disable public access or test DNS.

policies.displayName: BotService resources should use private link
policies.notes: Audits absence of an Approved connection on Microsoft.BotService/botServices. Bot Service is not the separate Microsoft.HealthBot provider.

policies.displayName: Azure Databricks Workspaces should use private link
policies.notes: Audits absence of an Approved workspace private endpoint. Applies to all Databricks workspaces in scope, not only ones currently running AI.

policies.displayName: Audit - Allowed Cognitive Services Kinds
policies.notes: The live predicate is equivalent, but this is a System Policy definition. Azure refused publication of a custom initiative referencing it on 2026-09-23 with InvalidCreatePolicySetDefinitionRequest: the built-in can not be part of a custom policy set. Excluded; no silent fallback is performed by the deployment script.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Services resources should have key access disabled (disable local authentication)
policies.notes: Check all consumers and authoring tools for Entra authentication support before denying key access. Inspect the rule for covered resource types.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Search services should disable public network access
policies.notes: Optional private-only overlay. Do not assign this to scopes intended to allow approved public IPs; use the local selected-network policy there.

policies.displayName: Azure Machine Learning Workspaces should disable public network access
policies.notes: Optional private-only overlay. Approved-IP public access is valid under the local selected-network baseline; verify ML post-creation IP-rule sequencing.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Services resources should use Azure Private Link
policies.notes: Included for other AI services: Approved private endpoint on every Cognitive Services account and Azure AI Search service. Overlaps Foundry_PrivateEndpoint on Foundry accounts, so a Foundry account without an endpoint gets two findings.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Services resources should restrict network access
policies.notes: Only checks Cognitive Services defaultAction or presence of Search IP rules. It does not compare actual IP/subnet entries to an organizational allowlist or govern egress. Use the local selected-network definition for stricter source validation.

policies.displayName: Azure Machine Learning and Ai Studio should use Allow Only Approved Outbound Managed Vnet mode
policies.notes: Core reference fixes isolationMode to AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound, not the built-in's Disabled mode default. Audit only; does not configure the managed network or approve individual outbound exceptions.

policies.displayName: Azure Machine Learning Computes should be in a virtual network
policies.notes: Validate how this definition represents managed-network compute versus customer-managed subnets before interpreting findings.

policies.displayName: Configure Azure Machine Learning workspace to use private DNS zones
policies.notes: Excluded from the audit-only baseline: only DeployIfNotExists/Disabled are supported. Do not invent an Audit effect. Audit zone associations and test DNS resolution separately.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Search services should have local authentication methods disabled
Azure Machine Learning Computes should have local authentication methods disabled
policies.notes: Targets ML compute, not managed online endpoint authentication modes.

policies.displayName: Cognitive Services accounts should use a managed identity
Azure Machine Learning workspaces should use user-assigned managed identity
policies.notes: An organizational lifecycle choice; do not imply that system-assigned identities are inherently insecure.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Services resources should encrypt data at rest with a customer-managed key (CMK)
policies.notes: Assign only where compliance requires customer-managed keys and the account kind supports them.

policies.displayName: Azure AI Search services should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
Configure Azure AI Search services to enforce customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
policies.notes: Excluded from the audit-only baseline: no supported audit effect. Use B14 for observation and assess object-level encryption separately.

policies.displayName: Azure Machine Learning workspaces should be encrypted with a customer-managed key
Cognitive Services accounts should use customer owned storage
policies.notes: Inspect kind exclusions and supported storage integration. Not every Cognitive Services kind supports this pattern.

policies.displayName: Foundry model deployments should only use approved models
policies.notes: Selected by the 2026-09-24 six-control request. This Microsoft.CognitiveServices.Data built-in grants approval by publisher OR an allowed asset-ID substring, not exact model name/version matching. Both empty lists approve nothing. Use narrow full asset identifiers when possible and assign only at Foundry account scopes; no model or publisher is preapproved.

policies.displayName: Foundry model deployments should meet eligibility requirements
policies.notes: GA 1.0.1 in the live catalogue (Microsoft.CognitiveServices.Data mode). Selected 2026-09-24 with denyPreviewModels fixed to true and onlyAllowDirectFromAzure fixed to false, so only preview-model deployments are reported. Applies to every Cognitive Services model deployment, including Azure OpenAI accounts.

policies.displayName: [Preview]: Azure Machine Learning Deployments should only use approved Registry Models
[Preview]: Azure Machine Learning Model Registry Deployments are restricted except for the allowed Registry
policies.notes: Excluded from the audit-only baseline: no supported audit effect. Source registry assessment needs a separate verified audit rule; B20's model allowlist is not automatically equivalent.

policies.displayName: [Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments should only use allowed prompt content filtering
[Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments should only use allowed completion content filtering
[Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments should only use allowed control
[Preview]: Cognitive Services Deployments Should Only Use Allowed Control Mode
[Preview]: Cognitive Services Agents should only use allowed prompt content filtering
[Preview]: Cognitive Services Agents should only use allowed control
Diagnostic logs in Azure AI services resources should be enabled
Resource logs in Azure Machine Learning Workspaces should be enabled
Resource logs in Search services should be enabled
Enable logging by category group for Cognitive Services (microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts) to Log Analytics
policies.notes: Use AuditIfNotExists with an approved destination and log category group. Do not select DeployIfNotExists or configure remediation for this audit-only pack.

policies.displayName: Azure Machine Learning compute instances should be recreated to get the latest software updates
policies.notes: The effect parameter is plural: effects. The source checks ComputeInstance osImageMetadata.isLatestOsImageVersion; it does not recreate compute.

[Preview]: Azure AI Search Service should be Zone Redundant
Azure Machine Learning Compute Instance should have idle shutdown.

policies.notes: Selected for the requested private-endpoint-existence baseline, including applicable Hub/Project workspace kinds. Does not require public access to be disabled and does not prove end-to-end connectivity.
